summary: Develop case theories, trace proceeds, and plan cross-border evidence in advanced prosecution training. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Anti-corruption and financial crime prosecution training is for prosecutors, investigators, and asset-recovery specialists working on cases involving corruption, laundering, and proceeds. Participants practise building case theories, tracing funds, assessing documentary and digital evidence, and planning cross-border evidence requests and asset-recovery steps for review against applicable law and procedures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who investigate, prosecute, or support complex corruption and financial crime cases, including cases with cross-border evidence and proceeds.
prerequisites: Prior experience in criminal investigation, prosecution, financial intelligence, forensic accounting, or asset recovery is recommended. You should be familiar with case files and evidence-handling responsibilities in your professional setting. No coding or programming is required; advanced digital-evidence and AI-assisted triage topics are addressed at operational or conceptual level.
